mode: deterministic derivation and exact stochastic control, no fitted covariance and no new random clouds

scope.original_detector: same spatial ball and two full time windows as v0.12; rigorous Poisson zero-source moment constraints and truncation majorants, no fully evaluated ensemble mean/covariance
scope.joint_kernel: all orders from disjoint Poisson atoms with repeated independent thinning marks and explicit Palm insertions
scope.control: finite causal skeleton with Poisson interval weights; background points modify counts but are not themselves solution nodes; two node-output channels, not the original spatial detector
scope.nonlocal_adapter: not a total ensemble map yet; no silently discarded or zero-filled projection failures
scope.oscillator: independent solvable random-frequency control with correlated Cauchy data and exact integration over shifted original time windows
